candidates.label: one full DemoDistributor claim (SELECTED)
candidates.assessment: Matches exactly what a real demo user receives from claimDemoBundle() and would plausibly sweep. Negligible price impact (0.208% at the recommended 5 MON pool size) on this route. Selected as the smoke amount.

candidates.label: previously-tested amount from the earlier fork validation
candidates.assessment: 50x a real claim - not representative of real demo usage and causes needless price impact (5-23% depending on pool size) on a correctly-sized small demo pool. Rejected for the smoke test; useful only as an earlier stress-test data point.
